evidence.name: Screen field: Order the button and renewal note
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Order the button and renewal note" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Order the button and renewal note
sections.description: Sets whether the purchase button sits above the auto-renew disclosure or below it. Button-first is the common, conversion-friendly default. Put the disclosure first when you want the renewal terms visible right above the button so users read them before tapping — often the safer choice for compliance.
